_comment: City blocks: textures and shapes, shared by the in-game block models and the preview. Boxes are [x0,y0,z0,x1,y1,z1,texture] in 1/16ths of a block, drawn facing north (front = -z); blocks with 'rotate' turn with their facing (north/east/south/west) or axis (x/z) property. Textures name files from tools/city/paint_textures.py; a cube's 'height' (16ths) lowers its top, and its 'tex' is one name or {up, down, side, north, south, east, west}.
